criteria.criterion: `agent.plan` accepts `claude` (default) and `copilot`, from the file and from `VLOOP_AGENT_PLAN`, and refuses any other value with exit 2.
criteria.evidence: internal/config/config.go: agents now includes copilot and agent.plan uses it; config_test.go TestAgentKeys covers plan=copilot and rejection of other values.

criteria.criterion: With `agent.plan = copilot`, each plan session — the first and the revision a failed gate-review round asks for — runs `copilot -p "/vloop:plan <brief path>"` with the model and effort P-6 resolves, the plugin by `--plugin-dir`, a fresh home under `.vloop/tmp/` holding a hooks file that runs `fence hook --phase plan` in both command forms, the guidelines as custom instructions, and the same `--deny-tool` list as a Copilot review session — `--deny-tool=shell(rm:*)` and `--deny-tool=shell(git push:*)` included. A plan session started without the hooks file, with another phase in it, or without `shell(rm:*)` is a violation.
criteria.evidence: agent_copilot.go Supports(plan) now true; Command skips shell(rm:*) only for PhaseWork, so plan keeps the full list; Prepare writes hooks with the phase. TestCopilotPlanArgvAndHooks checks prompt, every denial and --phase plan.

criteria.criterion: A Copilot plan session's JSON Lines become a `session/v4` record with phase `plan`, agent `copilot`, the model, credits, estimated cost, `cost_source` and `permission_denials`; it validates as session/v4. A Claude plan record keeps its schema as at the base.
criteria.evidence: session.go:464 adds PhasePlan to the copilot v4 selection; the test checks plan/copilot is v4 and plan/claude is v3; session.v4.json enum includes plan.

criteria.criterion: Everything around the plan session is unchanged whatever the agent: `planning from <brief> using <model>`; a moved ref halts with exit 9 (`vloop: REFS MOVED plan — the planning session changed git refs; nothing was committed`); a timeout halts with exit 7; no plan halts with exit 1 (`vloop: planning produced no .vloop/state/state.json`), as do a plan failing `state/v2` or the gate-shape checks; the base gates, the gate review and its two rounds; the plan commit. The one change: a plan session that exits non-zero halts with `vloop: planning session failed (<agent> exited <n>) — see <run folder>`, `copilot` for a Copilot session and `claude`, as at the base, for a Claude one. Planner code that otherwise branches on the agent, or a fallback to Claude when a Copilot plan session fails, is a violation.
criteria.evidence: plan.go diff only changes the non-zero exit line through planFailure(agent,...); no other branching or fallback. TestPlanFailureNamesTheAgent covers both agents.

criteria.criterion: A Copilot work, review, second-review, verify or gate-review session's argv and hooks file are unchanged (work without `shell(rm:*)` and `--phase work`; the others with it and their own phase); a Claude session's argv, fence and settings are unchanged — a Claude plan session still runs under the plan fence.
criteria.evidence: Command and hooks code are untouched apart from Supports; the Claude adapter is not in the diff.

criteria.criterion: Committed Go tests cover the adapter's plan argv (the whole deny list, `shell(rm:*)` included), its hooks file's `--phase plan`, `Supports(plan)`, the plan record's schema, `agent.plan` accepting copilot and the exit line for each agent; tests that pinned plan as unsupported or `agent.plan` as claude-only (`TestCopilotSupportsWorkReviewAndVerify` among them) or the old exit line change only to the new behaviour, and the work notes name the contract item (P2).
criteria.evidence: The tests listed above were added; the changed earlier tests (Supports, TestAgentKeys) only flip plan to the new behaviour. Checks log go exit 0.

notes: The record test checks only the schema name, not validation against session/v4. The schema enum permits plan, so this is minor. The work notes are not verifiable from the diff.
